notes: A digital marketing agency selling SEO, local SEO, websites, ads, PR, social media, design, apps and retainers, to rename and reprice. Featured Directory Listing is for agencies that run a local directory; delete it if you do not. Adding it sets everything up and switches it on; there is nothing to choose. Order forms wait until Fluent Forms can take payments. Each is a checkout: the choices first, then what the service includes and its questions, in two thirds, and Your order (running total, discount code and button) in one third, below the form on phones. Link Building uses only free Fluent Forms: packs with a quantity and prices beside each choice. Local SEO, added with Fluent Forms Pro, adds a phone field, photo uploads, discount codes and bank transfer (turn on coupons and offline payments in Fluent Forms → Payments). To add a service, copy an order form, rename it “Service Order Form” and put it on a page.

fluentform_forms.title: Local SEO Order Form
fluentform_forms.intro:
Get found on Google Maps and in local search. We optimise your Google Business Profile for the searches your customers make near you, and list your business where they look.

What you get

  • Business name, description, categories and services written around local search terms
  • Your name, address and phone number checked and matched everywhere you are listed
  • Logo, cover and photos from your website and social media, with search-friendly file names
  • Questions and answers, and posts shared from your social media
  • A map ranking report for your search terms, around your location

What we need from you

  • Manager access to your Google Business Profile and full access to Search Console. Never give an agency Owner access.
  • Someone at your premises who can answer Google's verification checks.
